turns.text: Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: billing | bug | account. Ticket: 'The app crashes every time I export a report to PDF.' Answer with the label only.

For your records, the labeling rubric: crashes, blank outputs, or wrong behavior of a feature are product defects (label: bug); charges, refunds, and invoices are billing; login and access problems are account. Acknowledge in one line.
